name: 3-Sided Oil Proof Aluminum Foil Splatter Guard | Foldable Heat Insulation for Kitchen Stove | Silver
description:
Keep your kitchen clean and protected with this 3-Sided Oil Proof Aluminum Foil Splatter Guard. Designed to block oil splashes while cooking, it prevents stains on stove walls and nearby surfaces. The foldable and compact design makes it easy to store, while the durable aluminum foil material ensures long-lasting performance. Suitable for both single and double stoves, it can be adjusted into various shapes for versatile use.
Key Features
 Effective oil splatter protection – prevents messy walls
 Foldable & space-saving design for easy storage
 Heat insulation prevents seasoning bottles from melting
 Versatile use – fits single or double stoves
 Easy to clean – rinse or wipe with a damp cloth
How to Use
 Place the guard around the stove before cooking
 Adjust into L-shape or U-shape as needed
 After use, wipe clean and fold for storage
Material
Durable aluminum foil
Safety Information
 Keep away from open flames
 Avoid bending too forcefully to prevent damage
 Store in a dry place when not in use
Package Includes
 1 × 3-Sided Oil Proof Aluminum Foil Splatter Guard
